basic_info.description: Stylish Corner-Unit Condo in Resort-Like Community at Lake Merced Hills. Welcome to this beautifully renovated corner-unit condo, perfectly situated in the sought-after Lake Merced Hills community. Combining modern elegance with everyday comfort.  Freshly painted with new flooring throughout, this spacious residence features 2 large bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and a flexible office/den-ideal for remote work or creative pursuits. The fully renovated kitchen features modern cabinetry and top-tier appliances, and ample storage. Step out onto your private deck to relax and enjoy the outdoors, and enjoy the ease of an in-unit washer and dryer for ultimate convenience.    Residents enjoy a wealth of premium amenities including a swimming pool, sauna, tennis courts, a clubhouse, 24-hour security, and dedicated parking. Located just minutes from Fort Funston Beach and steps from scenic Lake Merced, this home provides the ultimate blend of nature and city living. With close proximity to shopping, dining, and major transit options like the 280 Freeway and Daly City BART, this is a rare opportunity not to be missed.
